conventions.convention: Variance is the finite weighted expectation of (X−E[X])²; no extra moment hypothesis is needed.
The Bernoulli law has n≥1 and 0<p<1. Logarithms are natural; D(0∥p)=−log(1−p) and D(1∥p)=−log p. Tail events include equality.

The three sectors have multiplicities 1, 1, 4^N and energies 0, Nε, 2Nε, with counting reference measure. Canonical interpretation requires β>0; β≤0 is only an algebraic extension. Shell half-width satisfies 0≤Δ<Nε.

Product-additivity requires one fixed finite alphabet and one fixed one-site energy for the entire size-indexed family. A first-order transition means unequal finite one-sided limits of the limiting mean energy at a positive β.
The walk assumes full AC, uses ℓ²=2Dδt and n=floor(t/δt), includes the empty product at n=0, and asserts fixed-time marginal weak convergence only.
Rotor angles lie in R/(2πZ), mixing is defined relative to the invariant uniform-angle law at fixed nonzero momentum, and finite Shannon entropy uses natural logarithms with 0 log 0=0.

load_bearing.statement: For the specified three-sector family, Pβ,N(B_N)≤1/(2^(N+1)+1) for every real β, while the stated shell assigns B_N probability 1. The normalized log partition converges to max{0,log 4−2βε} with error at most log 3/N. For β>0 the limiting mean energy is 2ε below βc=(log 2)/ε, ε at βc, and 0 above βc; every finite normalized log partition is real analytic.
Its variance is Var(X):=E[(X−E[X])²] on the stated finite probability space.

For the stipulated finite Bernoulli product law, EK=np and Var(K)=np(1−p). For every ε>0, P(|K/n−p|≥ε)≤p(1−p)/(nε²) and ≤2 exp(−2nε²). The stated one-sided tails are bounded by exp(−nD(a∥p)); at a=k/n, the mass P(K=k) lies between exp(−nD(a∥p))/(n+1) and exp(−nD(a∥p)), giving the stated interior limiting exponential rate.

Assuming AC, the stipulated symmetric walk has the stated moments, lattice recurrence and characteristic function, and its fixed-time laws converge to N(0,2Dt). The specified nonzero-momentum rotor is periodic, is not mixing for its invariant orbit law, and its evolving point law has no weak limit. The specified permutation has coarse entropies 0, log 2, 0 and constant fine entropy log 2 at times 0, 1, 2.

seams_checked.note: The preparation postulate permits the separately stipulated product laws and restricts canonical interpretation to β>0. The walk item accurately states the smooth-flow fine-entropy supplier's regularity, positivity and volume-preservation hypotheses, and explicitly distinguishes it from the finite coarse-entropy counterexample.

The commuting-lattice item's F4 and proof identify the same sector energies and multiplicities. Its middle-sector bound, strict shell-width condition, log-partition error bound, critical parameter and piecewise mean-energy limit match the classical supplier. Canonical claims retain β>0; arbitrary real β is confined to the algebraic extension.
